=== step 1: dashcrew "help" "commit" "lint"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Check commit messages against project.commit; exit 1 with one line per problem.
| Checks the pattern, type, subject length, body, trailers and AI attribution of one message, or of every
| commit of --range but merges.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew commit lint <message> | - | --range <base>..<head>
| -h, --help       Print this usage information.
| -p, --project    Any folder inside the repository.
|                  (defaults to ".")
|     --range      Lint the commits of <base>..<head> instead of a message.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
